review:
Deep space on a 7x7 cluster grid – asteroids, stars and moons. Five or more touching symbols win and cascade. The star is the black hole: it pulls in every copy of a random symbol and pays them as a cluster at the end, setting off more tumbles.

Three or more scatters give free spins, up to 50, where black holes can carry multipliers up to 10x. Up to 10,000x and 96.09% RTP. Genuinely different from Pragmatic's other cluster games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
